title: Evidence map: macroscopic brain lesions in H5N1-infected mammals
note_box:
histopathology of H5N1 neurotropism exists, but gross macroscopic brain-lesion
records at necropsy are absent across all systems
caption: Ferret models document lethal disease and droplet transmission; Chile's marine-mammal outbreak was 100% fatal — but gross brain pathology at necropsy is unrecorded in any system.
